svg.title: CNN denoising pretraining from ImageFolder images to an exported encoder
svg.desc: A standalone five-stage flow for the repository's separate two-dimensional CNN denoising pretraining lane. ImageFolder images are transformed, deterministically split, and wrapped as noisy and clean pairs. A four-level convolutional encoder feeds a skip-connected decoder. Validation compares denoised outputs with clean targets using MSE and PSNR, then the best checkpoint is restored and the encoder is exported to encoder_best.pth. A lower contract band records train drop-last behavior, image-count guards, optional reconstruction-grid output, and metrics.json with test_metrics null. This path is independent from BraTS segmentation.

g.text: ImageFolder pixels become clean reconstruction targets, then a best-checkpoint encoder becomes a transfer-ready artifact.
no NIfTI volumes · no case manifest · no segmentation labels
root must exist · at least 2 images
active config: RGB; implementation supports 1 or 3 channels
noisy input → denoised prediction → clean target
ready for later weight transfer · no BraTS branch
N = selected dataset_size ≥ 2 · n_val = max(1, floor(N · val_fraction))
torch.randperm selects subset before split; generator is seeded.
A tiny ImageFolder can fail before training if no valid train batch remains.
val: drop_last = False · final validation batch kept
When train drop_last is true, remainder images are not yielded.
Keep train_count ≥ batch_size for at least one training batch.
Optional grid is opt-in; exported file is encoder_best.pth.
CNN/ImageFolder path ends here; it does not enter BraTS segmentation training.
hand-authored SVG · embedded styles · internal markers only · grayscale-safe hierarchy
